content.text: Many digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan face significant barriers when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-now[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-2|USDT Payment]]s-webhooks-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-7|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-workers-works-4|setting]] up an online store. Conventional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal are either unavailable or heavily restricted, leaving creators with limited options. Building your own digital store using Cloudflare Pages provides a robust infrastructure that eliminates reliance on traditional payment solutions. In this guide, you'll learn how to deploy a fully operational digital store that accepts crypto payments without the need for Stripe, while maintaining full ownership of your data and products.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The primary advantage of using Cloudflare Pages and the COREMERCH infrastructure is sovereignty. Unlike conventional platforms that can impose restrictions or shut down accounts, this setup grants you full control over your digital store. With Cloudflare Pages, your content is hosted securely, while NOWPayments ensures that you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This infrastructure model is designed to withstand the challenges posed by unstable financial systems in regions where traditional payment processors fail. By owning your stack, you eliminate the risks associated with third-party dependencies.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting your deployment, gather essential components: a GitHub account for hosting, a Cloudflare account for configuration, and access to NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, which will manage your backend logic. Additionally, prepare your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, and ensure they are ready for upload. Understanding the Sovereign Blueprint will also streamline your deployment process, making it easier to configure your store efficiently. Following these preparatory steps will set you up for a smooth deployment experience.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring the NOWPayments integration within your Cloudflare environment. This will allow for seamless crypto payment processing on your digital store. Next, set up Google Apps Script to handle order management and automate product delivery. Make sure to test the payment workflow thoroughly to confirm that transactions are processed correctly. Utilize webhook functionality from NOWPayments to ensure your system is alerted immediately when a payment is confirmed. This setup guarantees that customers receive their purchases instantly upon successful payment confirmation, enhancing their overall experience.
Take control of your financial future by deploying your own digital store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is configured, it's time to go live. Deploy your GitHub Pages site and ensure that all settings are correctly applied. Conduct thorough testing of the payment flow by making a small purchase with a cryptocurrency to confirm that everything works as intended. Once you’ve successfully processed your first transaction, monitor the system for any issues and make adjustments as necessary. This phase is crucial as it validates your store's functionality and prepares you for scaling up as you attract more customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing a functional digital store, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Start by adding more products and utilizing analytics tools to track customer behavior. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if your needs grow, as it offers enhanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and support for more products. Engage with your audience through marketing strategies that drive traffic to your store. With the right scaling tactics, your store can grow into a sustainable source of income, fully leveraging the sovereignty and security of your infrastructure.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
No reliance on traditional payment processors means greater sovereignty.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform provides the necessary infrastructure to create a secure online store that can handle crypto payments efficiently.
How long does it take to set up Stack 01?
Deploying Stack 01 typically takes between 4 to 6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, allowing you to get your digital store up and running quickly without delays.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments enables you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low transaction fee of 0.5%. It requires no KYC and provides instant payment verification through webhooks, ensuring a smooth transaction experience.
